performance.verdict: Spend halved; CPL improved, but 3-day leads collapsed and GHL is blind.

findings.text: 3 overdue SOW milestones (renewal attribution gap 7/23, phone-match 8/7, CRM cleanup 8/14) unresolved in Full Smile's prove-it month.
CPL improved 36.47% WoW to ~$7.63, but last 3 days averaged 3.3 leads vs prior 3-day avg of 5.7 — volume is deteriorating as spend hits $22/day floor.
GHL returned a 401 timeout error — pipeline data is unavailable. Lead-to-opportunity conversion cannot be verified during the prove-it month.
GBP actions dropped 33.33% WoW and show 0 for Aug 20–21; IG reach fell 52.35% WoW to 88–89/day — organic signals contracting alongside paid pullback.
GA4 sessions nearly doubled (+94.92% WoW, averaging ~15/day last 3 days) while leads fell — traffic-to-lead conversion is decoupling, suggesting a possible form or tracking gap.

suggestions.text: Restore GHL auth immediately — pipeline visibility is broken during the prove-it month.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL is returning a 401 timeout error, cutting off all pipeline and lead-to-patient tracking at the worst possible time — August is the renewal prove-it month. Ahmed/Ali to rotate or refresh the GHL API token and confirm sync resumes within 24 hours. Success: GHL pipeline loads without error by 2026-08-23. This also blocks progress on the overdue CRM cleanup milestone (due 8/14).

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% from ~$22/day floor — CPL is strong at ~$7.63 but 3-day lead volume is collapsing.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL improved 36.47% WoW to approximately $7.63, but the last 3 days averaged only 3.3 leads as spend dropped to the $22/day floor — volume is being starved, not efficiency-limited. Raise the Meta daily budget by 20% (from ~$22 to ~$26/day), prioritising the BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign which led 28-day spend at $723.41. Success check: 3-day lead average returns to 5+ leads/day by 2026-08-25 without CPL exceeding the 28-day baseline of $11.19.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session-to-lead decoupling — sessions up 94.92% but leads fell; confirm form tracking before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions nearly doubled (+94.92% WoW, ~15/day last 3 days) while Meta leads declined — this divergence could indicate a broken lead form, a GA4 goal mis-fire, or the known GA4 double-count issue. Do not act yet; this is hypothesis-grade. Re-check on 2026-08-25: if sessions remain elevated and leads do not recover after the Meta budget step-up (S2), escalate to a tracking audit.
